response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience, deep technical breadth across languages (including C, C++, D, JavaScript/TypeScript), and a proven track record in distributed systems and open-source tooling, but lacks explicit evidence of building enterprise-scale experimentation or growth platforms, feature-flagging systems, or AI-driven measurement frameworks central to the role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience with distributed systems and high-throughput services (e.g., millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Strong open-source contributions and tooling development (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial) demonstrating initiative and systems thinking
Proven ability to work across stacks and languages, including C/C++ and TypeScript, with clear focus on testability and quality
concerns: No clear evidence of designing or owning experimentation frameworks, feature flighting, or guardrail systems at scale
Lack of demonstrated experience with AI tools accelerating engineering velocity or integrating AI into growth systems
Limited visibility into cross-team stakeholder alignment or leadership in unifying measurement systems across products
